required_inputs: E3 sealed JOINT plans for 50c and 100c
foundation frozen common initial solution for 150c
wiring_gate.minimum_complete_model_evaluation: one deterministic feasibility and objective evaluation for every arm; no candidate search
wiring_gate.whole_trip_release_state: before the probe, cut the initial certificate at the first trigger for all three scales; an in-progress whole trip releases at its certified return time and terminal battery, with all of its charging actions locked
wiring_gate.in_progress_route_charging_witness: a future charging action carried by an already-departed immutable trip is retained in the committed ledger and witnessed at its observed certified start
wiring_gate.alns_current_objective_binding: before the long probe, construct the first event stage and bind a finite reference-channel objective to every search-enabled arm without consuming a candidate evaluation
wiring_gate.spawn_worker_serialization: before formal execution, serialize the inherited worker under a stable registered module identity
wiring_gate.legal_infeasible_classification: retain a frozen-fleet event-stage infeasibility as LEGAL_INFEASIBLE with a null objective, exact candidate consumption and failure stage; every other exception remains a technical HALT
wiring_gate.trace_mode_guard: convergence-trace accounting is active only for the preregistered probe; formal tasks execute the same search without trace-row assertions
wiring_gate.no_executable_continuation_classificatio: the dedicated NoExecutableContinuation terminal is retained as LEGAL_INFEASIBLE with its candidate rejection summary and exact candidate consumption

budget.unit: complete candidate evaluations per rolling stage across shadow and released search
budget.selection: candidate exhaustion point when both passes exhaust, otherwise later strict-improvement point after a 10 percent plateau; round upward to a hundred with positive margin
